JOIN races ON results.raceid = races.raceid
JOIN seasons ON races.season = seasons.year
WHERE seasons.year > 2004
GROUP BY races.name, seasons.year
ORDER BY seasons.year
```

SELECT s.role_code, p.project_id
FROM staff_roles s
JOIN project_staff ps ON s.role_code = ps.role_code
JOIN (
    SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) as outcome_count
    FROM project_outcomes
    GROUP BY project_id
) po ON ps.project_id = po.project_id
WHERE po.outcome_count = (
    SELECT MAX(outcome_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) as outcome_count
        FROM project_outcomes
        GROUP BY project_id
    ) po_sub
)
```

SELECT s.role_code, s.role_description, COUNT(p.outcome_code) AS outcome_count
FROM staff_roles s
JOIN project_staff ps ON s.role_code = ps.role_code
JOIN projects p ON ps.project_id = p.project_id
JOIN project_outcomes po ON p.project_id = po.project_id
GROUP BY s.role_code, s.role_description
ORDER BY outcome_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

SELECT sr.role_code, ps.project_id
FROM staff_roles sr
JOIN project_staff ps ON sr.role_code = ps.role_code
JOIN (
    SELECT role_code, COUNT(*) as outcome_count
    FROM project_staff ps
    JOIN projects p ON ps.organisation_id = p.organisation_id
    JOIN project_outcomes po ON p.project_id = po.project_id
    GROUP BY role_code
    ORDER BY outcome_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) subq ON sr.role_code = subq.role_code
```

SELECT sr.role_code, ps.project_id
FROM staff_roles sr
JOIN project_staff ps ON sr.role_code = ps.role_code
JOIN (
    SELECT ps.role_code, COUNT(po.outcome_code) as outcome_count
    FROM project_staff ps
    JOIN project_outcomes po ON ps.project_id = po.project_id
    GROUP BY ps.role_code
    ORDER BY outcome_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) subq ON sr.role_code = subq.role_code
